units.id: mission:Raid Warning|When you enter the <origin> spaceport, you're almost immediately stopped by a grizzled old man. "You some kinda rookie, or you asking for a death wish?" he asks.|23|0
units.english: When you enter the <origin> spaceport, you're almost immediately stopped by a grizzled old man. "You some kinda rookie, or you asking for a death wish?" he asks.
units.italian: Quando entri nello spazioporto di <origin>, vieni quasi subito fermato da un vecchio burbero. "Sei una specie di pivello, o stai chiedendo la morte?" ti chiede.

units.id: mission:Raid Warning|	"Excuse me?"|25|0
units.english: "Excuse me?"
units.italian: "Come scusa?"

units.id: mission:Raid Warning|	"Yeah, I'm pretty fresh. Is there something I'm doing wrong by walking in here?"|27|0
units.english: "Yeah, I'm pretty fresh. Is there something I'm doing wrong by walking in here?"
units.italian: "Sì, sono abbastanza fresco. Sto forse sbagliando qualcosa entrando qui?"

units.id: mission:Raid Warning|	"I've been piloting for a while. I think I know what I'm doing."|28|0
units.english: "I've been piloting for a while. I think I know what I'm doing."
units.italian: "Piloto da un po'. Credo di sapere quello che faccio."

units.id: mission:Raid Warning|	The old man chuckles. "Ain't nothing wrong with walking in here. It's what you're flying in with that's the issue.|30|0
units.english: The old man chuckles. "Ain't nothing wrong with walking in here. It's what you're flying in with that's the issue.
units.italian: Il vecchio ridacchia. "Non c'è niente di sbagliato nell'entrare qui. È con quello che stai volando che hai il problema.

units.id: mission:Raid Warning|	The old man chuckles. "Well I don't think so after what I've seen.|34|0
units.english: The old man chuckles. "Well I don't think so after what I've seen.
units.italian: Il vecchio ridacchia. "Beh, non credo proprio, dopo quello che ho visto.

units.id: mission:Raid Warning|	"I seen those ships of yours. That fleet is juicy pickings for pirates if I've ever seen it." You look confusedly at the man. "Oh, do I need to spell it out for you? Pirates love to take out soft targets with lots of potential cargo, and your fleet is looking pretty heavy on cargo space with hardly any defenses."|37|0
units.english: "I seen those ships of yours. That fleet is juicy pickings for pirates if I've ever seen it." You look confusedly at the man. "Oh, do I need to spell it out for you? Pirates love to take out soft targets with lots of potential cargo, and your fleet is looking pretty heavy on cargo space with hardly any defenses."
units.italian: "Ho visto quelle navi che hai. Quella flotta è un bocconcino succoso per i pirati, se mai ne ho vista una." Lo guardi confuso. "Oh, devo spiegartelo per bene? Ai pirati piace eliminare bersagli morbidi con molto carico potenziale, e la tua flotta sembra bella carica di spazio per il carico e quasi priva di difese."

units.id: mission:Raid Warning|	"Oh, so that's why I've been seeing pirates everywhere I go."|39|0
units.english: "Oh, so that's why I've been seeing pirates everywhere I go."
units.italian: "Oh, quindi è per questo che vedevo pirati ovunque andassi."

units.id: mission:Raid Warning|	"So what should I do about that?"|40|0
units.english: "So what should I do about that?"
units.italian: "E cosa dovrei farci?"

units.id: mission:Raid Warning|	"Don't you think I know that already?"|42|0
units.english: "Don't you think I know that already?"
units.italian: "Non credi che lo sappia già?"

units.id: mission:Raid Warning|	"What, you think they just had it out for you because you look funny? No, pirates have their reasons.|44|0
units.english: "What, you think they just had it out for you because you look funny? No, pirates have their reasons.
units.italian: "Cosa, pensi che ce l'avessero con te perché hai un'aria buffa? No, i pirati hanno le loro ragioni.

units.id: mission:Raid Warning|	"Either get yourself more guns in that fleet or get rid of some cargo space. Park your ships, sell them, doesn't matter, so long as the pirates don't see them, or you make it not worth it to try and steal whatever you might have. Pirates see a bunch of freighters flying around unprotected and they're going to take their chances. Doesn't matter if you actually have anything or not."|46|0
units.english: "Either get yourself more guns in that fleet or get rid of some cargo space. Park your ships, sell them, doesn't matter, so long as the pirates don't see them, or you make it not worth it to try and steal whatever you might have. Pirates see a bunch of freighters flying around unprotected and they're going to take their chances. Doesn't matter if you actually have anything or not."
units.italian: "O ti procuri più cannoni in quella flotta o ti liberi di un po' di spazio per il carico. Parcheggia le navi, vendile, non importa, basta che i pirati non le vedano, o che tu renda lo sforzo di rubare quello che potresti avere non conveniente. I pirati vedono un mucchio di mercantili che volano senza protezione e si prendono il rischio. Non importa se hai davvero qualcosa o no."

units.id: mission:Raid Warning|	"Thanks for the advice."|48|0
units.english: "Thanks for the advice."
units.italian: "Grazie del consiglio."

units.id: mission:Raid Warning|	"I'll make sure to go do that. Thanks."|49|0
units.english: "I'll make sure to go do that. Thanks."
units.italian: "Mi assicurerò di farlo. Grazie."

units.id: mission:Raid Warning|	"No problem. Just looking out for a fellow captain. No use in getting got because you didn't know any better. But now you do." The man gives you a firm pat on the back before walking off.|50|0
units.english: "No problem. Just looking out for a fellow captain. No use in getting got because you didn't know any better. But now you do." The man gives you a firm pat on the back before walking off.
units.italian: "Nessun problema. Sto solo badando a un collega capitano. Non serve a niente farsi fregare perché non sapevi come stanno le cose. Ma ora lo sai." L'uomo ti dà una pacca ferma sulla schiena prima di allontanarsi.

units.id: mission:Raid Warning|	"Sure doesn't look like it." The man gives an exaggerated shrug and starts to walk off. "Alright then, get yourself killed. Not like I used to haul cargo from one end of the galaxy to the other for fifty years or anything." The man gets further and further away, continuing to grumble about "kids these days" and other such things until you can no longer hear him.|54|0
units.english: "Sure doesn't look like it." The man gives an exaggerated shrug and starts to walk off. "Alright then, get yourself killed. Not like I used to haul cargo from one end of the galaxy to the other for fifty years or anything." The man gets further and further away, continuing to grumble about "kids these days" and other such things until you can no longer hear him.
units.italian: "Non sembra affatto." L'uomo fa un'alzata di spalle esagerata e comincia ad allontanarsi. "Va bene allora, fatti ammazzare. Mica ho passato cinquanta anni a trasportare merci da un capo all'altro della galassia." L'uomo si allontana sempre di più, continuando a borbottare di "questi ragazzi di oggi" e cose del genere finché non riesci più a sentirlo.

units.id: mission:Hunted Warning|log|70|0
units.english: Got noticed at a spaceport bar as a "famous warrior." Was warned to look out for bounty hunters or pirates hoping to make a name for themselves.
units.italian: Ti sei fatto notare in un bar dello spazioporto come "famoso guerriero". Ti è stato consigliato di stare attento ai cacciatori di taglie o ai pirati che sperano di farsi un nome.

units.id: mission:Hunted Warning|You walk into a bar in the spaceport looking for something to eat when a man sitting at a table in the corner looks up and takes notice of you. "It's Captain <last>, the famous warrior! Barkeep, give <first> a drink on my tab."|72|0
units.english: You walk into a bar in the spaceport looking for something to eat when a man sitting at a table in the corner looks up and takes notice of you. "It's Captain <last>, the famous warrior! Barkeep, give <first> a drink on my tab."
units.italian: Entri in un bar dello spazioporto in cerca di qualcosa da mangiare quando un uomo seduto a un tavolo nell'angolo alza lo sguardo e ti nota. "È il Capitano <last>, il famoso guerriero! Barista, offri da bere a <first>, pagamento mio."

units.id: mission:Hunted Warning|	"Glad to get some recognition. I work hard out here."|74|0
units.english: "Glad to get some recognition. I work hard out here."
units.italian: "Contento di ricevere un po' di riconoscimento. Lavoro sodo da queste parti."

units.id: mission:Hunted Warning|	"Famous warrior?"|76|0
units.english: "Famous warrior?"
units.italian: "Famoso guerriero?"

units.id: mission:Hunted Warning|	"Of course! Word travels fast in the galaxy, and word on the hyperspace lanes is that you're quite the fighter."|77|0
units.english: "Of course! Word travels fast in the galaxy, and word on the hyperspace lanes is that you're quite the fighter."
units.italian: "Ma certo! Le voci viaggiano in fretta nella galassia, e sulle rotte dell'iperspazio si dice che tu sia un bell'avversario."

units.id: mission:Hunted Warning|	"It doesn't help that you've pissed off the law, either," someone behind you says, not sounding too happy.|84|0
units.english: "It doesn't help that you've pissed off the law, either," someone behind you says, not sounding too happy.
units.italian: "E non aiuta il fatto che tu abbia fatto arrabbiare la legge," dice qualcuno dietro di te, senza sembrare troppo contento.

units.id: mission:Hunted Warning|	More patrons take notice of the conversation and begin chattering amongst themselves. "Quite the force to be reckoned with, I've heard," you overhear one of them mumble.|86|0
units.english: More patrons take notice of the conversation and begin chattering amongst themselves. "Quite the force to be reckoned with, I've heard," you overhear one of them mumble.
units.italian: Altri avventori notano la conversazione e cominciano a chiacchierare tra loro. "Una bella forza con cui fare i conti, a quanto ho sentito," senti borbottare uno di loro.

units.id: mission:Hunted Warning|	"You might want to watch your back," another says to you. "Plenty of pirates with more brains than sense might be looking to make a name for themselves by taking out such a famous captain. A person like you has to have some enemies, and you never know who might have put a price on your head. A bounty hunter could retire early on the fat purse they'd get from spacing you."|87|0
units.english: "You might want to watch your back," another says to you. "Plenty of pirates with more brains than sense might be looking to make a name for themselves by taking out such a famous captain. A person like you has to have some enemies, and you never know who might have put a price on your head. A bounty hunter could retire early on the fat purse they'd get from spacing you."
units.italian: "Forse ti conviene guardarti le spalle," ti dice un altro. "Molti pirati con più cervello che giudizio potrebbero cercare di farsi un nome abbattendo un capitano così famoso. Una persona come te deve avere dei nemici, e non sai mai chi potrebbe aver messo una taglia sulla tua testa. Un cacciatore di taglie potrebbe andare in pensione presto con la borsa grassa che si prenderebbe mandandoti nello spazio."

units.id: mission:Hunted Warning|	"I'll be fine. My ship is strong enough to stand against anything."|89|0
units.english: "I'll be fine. My ship is strong enough to stand against anything."
units.italian: "Starò bene. La mia nave è abbastanza forte da reggere qualsiasi cosa."

units.id: mission:Hunted Warning|	"Maybe I should go into hiding for a while."|90|0
units.english: "Maybe I should go into hiding for a while."
units.italian: "Forse dovrei nascondermi per un po'."

units.id: mission:Hunted Warning|	"Oh, I'm sure it is. You wouldn't have gotten this notorious without being able to hold your own."|92|0
units.english: "Oh, I'm sure it is. You wouldn't have gotten this notorious without being able to hold your own."
units.italian: "Oh, ne sono certo. Non saresti diventato così famigerato se non sapessi difenderti."

units.id: mission:Hunted Warning|	"You'd need to hide for more than just a while, but laying low in a small ship might help to stay off the radar of pirates and bounty hunters."|95|0
units.english: "You'd need to hide for more than just a while, but laying low in a small ship might help to stay off the radar of pirates and bounty hunters."
units.italian: "Dovresti nasconderti per più di un po', ma stare basso con una nave piccola potrebbe aiutarti a rimanere fuori dal radar dei pirati e dei cacciatori di taglie."

units.id: mission:Hunted Warning|	After a few more minutes of mumbling, the bar returns to like it was before you entered. The food you ordered arrives and you dig in.|97|0
units.english: After a few more minutes of mumbling, the bar returns to like it was before you entered. The food you ordered arrives and you dig in.
units.italian: Dopo qualche altro minuto di borbottii, il bar torna com'era prima che entrassi. Il cibo che hai ordinato arriva e ti metti a mangiare.

units.id: mission:Immigrant Workers|description|195|0
units.english: A young couple wants to start a new life on <destination>, and can pay you <payment> to bring them there. They are also bringing along <cargo>.
units.italian: Una giovane coppia vuole iniziare una nuova vita su <destination> e può pagarti <payment> per portarli lì. Portano anche <cargo>.

units.id: mission:Immigrant Workers|dialog|209|0
units.english: The young couple from <origin> pays you and thanks you profusely as they gather up their goods and depart. You wish them the best of luck in their new life on <planet>.
units.italian: La giovane coppia da <origin> ti paga e ti ringrazia profusamente mentre raccoglie le sue cose e parte. Auguri loro ogni fortuna nella nuova vita su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Immigrant Workers|log|210|0
units.english: George and Samantha used to work on New Iceland before they decided to leave due to Samantha's conditions.
units.italian: George e Samantha lavoravano su New Iceland prima di decidere di andarsene per le condizioni di Samantha.

units.id: mission:Immigrant Workers|As you leave your ship and walk toward the cafeteria at the center of the spaceport, you notice a young couple standing near the edge of the landing area next to a cart loaded high with a jumble of boxes and furniture. Like many of the locals, they are both wearing dust masks over their mouths, and the woman is also wearing goggles.|213|0
units.english: As you leave your ship and walk toward the cafeteria at the center of the spaceport, you notice a young couple standing near the edge of the landing area next to a cart loaded high with a jumble of boxes and furniture. Like many of the locals, they are both wearing dust masks over their mouths, and the woman is also wearing goggles.
units.italian: Mentre esci dalla nave e cammini verso la mensa al centro dello spazioporto, noti una giovane coppia ferma vicino al bordo dell'area di atterraggio, accanto a un carrello carico fino in cima di scatole e mobili alla rinfusa. Come molti della gente del posto, hanno entrambi maschere antipolvere sulla bocca, e la donna porta anche gli occhiali protettivi.

units.id: mission:Immigrant Workers|	(Talk to them.)|215|0
units.english: (Talk to them.)
units.italian: (Parla con loro.)

units.id: mission:Immigrant Workers|	(Ignore them.)|216|0
units.english: (Ignore them.)
units.italian: (Ignali.)

units.id: mission:Immigrant Workers|	The couple introduces themselves as George and Samantha. As you shake hands with them, you notice that Samantha's eyes under the goggles are rimmed in red, and she keeps coughing quietly: a dry, careful cough. George explains that they came here several years ago to take jobs in the factories, but the volcanic fumes have been giving Samantha trouble ever since they arrived. They can pay <payment> for transport for themselves and <tons> of household goods to <destination>.|218|0
units.english: The couple introduces themselves as George and Samantha. As you shake hands with them, you notice that Samantha's eyes under the goggles are rimmed in red, and she keeps coughing quietly: a dry, careful cough. George explains that they came here several years ago to take jobs in the factories, but the volcanic fumes have been giving Samantha trouble ever since they arrived. They can pay <payment> for transport for themselves and <tons> of household goods to <destination>.
units.italian: La coppia si presenta come George e Samantha. Mentre stringi loro la mano, noti che gli occhi di Samantha sotto gli occhiali sono cerchiati di rosso, e che tossisce piano di continuo: una tosse secca e prudente. George spiega che sono venuti qui diversi anni fa per lavorare nelle fabbriche, ma i fumi vulcanici hanno dato problemi a Samantha da quando sono arrivati. Possono pagare <payment> per il trasporto di loro due e di <tons> di beni domestici fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Immigrant Workers|	(Accept.)|220|0
units.english: (Accept.)
units.italian: (Accetta.)

units.id: mission:Immigrant Workers|	(Decline.)|221|0
units.english: (Decline.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta.)

units.id: mission:Immigrant Workers|	They thank you for your assistance, and you give them a hand pushing the heavy cart into your cargo bay.|223|0
units.english: They thank you for your assistance, and you give them a hand pushing the heavy cart into your cargo bay.
units.italian: Ti ringraziano per l'aiuto, e li aiuti a spingere il carrello pesante nella stiva della nave.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 1|name|232|0
units.english: Pookie
units.italian: Pookie

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 1|description|233|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> and meet Pookie, who is staying with her aunt and may be scared of flying.
units.italian: Vai su <destination> e incontra Pookie, che sta dalla zia e potrebbe avere paura di volare.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 1|As you walk through the spaceport, you hear a voice behind you, saying, "Excuse me, Captain." You turn around and see a woman trying to flag you down. Her hairdo is tall and somewhat confusing; her high heels are also tall and are giving her considerable trouble as she walks towards you.|240|0
units.english: As you walk through the spaceport, you hear a voice behind you, saying, "Excuse me, Captain." You turn around and see a woman trying to flag you down. Her hairdo is tall and somewhat confusing; her high heels are also tall and are giving her considerable trouble as she walks towards you.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, senti una voce dietro di te che dice: "Mi scusi, Capitano." Ti giri e vedi una donna che cerca di farsi notare. La sua acconciatura è alta e un po' confusa; anche i suoi tacchi alti sono alti e le stanno dando parecchio filo da torcere mentre cammina verso di te.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 1|	"You look like the sort of captain I can trust," she says. "My darling Pookie has been visiting her aunt on Shroud, and it's time for her to come home, but she's not used to space travel and it scares her. I would feel so much better if you could go pick her up and bring her back here. Can you do that for me?" You can't help noticing that the jewelry she's wearing probably costs as much as a small fighter craft. This job sounds easy, and has the potential to be quite lucrative.|241|0
units.english: "You look like the sort of captain I can trust," she says. "My darling Pookie has been visiting her aunt on Shroud, and it's time for her to come home, but she's not used to space travel and it scares her. I would feel so much better if you could go pick her up and bring her back here. Can you do that for me?" You can't help noticing that the jewelry she's wearing probably costs as much as a small fighter craft. This job sounds easy, and has the potential to be quite lucrative.
units.italian: "Lei sembra il tipo di capitano di cui mi posso fidare," dice. "La mia adorata Pookie è andata a trovare sua zia su Shroud, ed è ora che torni a casa, ma non è abituata ai viaggi spaziali e ne ha paura. Mi sentirei molto meglio se potessi andare a prenderla e riportarla qui. Può farlo per me?" Non puoi fare a meno di notare che i gioielli che indossa probabilmente costano quanto un piccolo caccia. Questo incarico sembra facile e potrebbe essere piuttosto redditizio.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 1|dialog|249|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but your escort with the space reserved for Pookie has not arrived! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la tua scorta con lo spazio riservato a Pookie non è arrivata! Meglio partire e attendere che le tue scorte arrivino in questo sistema stellare.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 2|name|254|0
units.english: Pookie
units.italian: Pookie

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 2|description|256|0
units.english: Return Pookie the poodle to <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta Pookie, la barboncina, su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 2|You called ahead while your ship was landing and agreed to meet Pookie's aunt at the spaceport. She told you, "Meet me outside the shop with the ridiculous sheepskin coats." The shop is not hard to find; the mannequins in the window look like feral sheep with overgrown wool in bad need of grooming.|265|0
units.english: You called ahead while your ship was landing and agreed to meet Pookie's aunt at the spaceport. She told you, "Meet me outside the shop with the ridiculous sheepskin coats." The shop is not hard to find; the mannequins in the window look like feral sheep with overgrown wool in bad need of grooming.
units.italian: Hai chiamato mentre la nave atterrava e hai concordato di incontrare la zia di Pookie allo spazioporto. Ti ha detto: "Ci vediamo fuori dal negozio con i ridicoli cappotti di pelle di pecora." Il negozio non è difficile da trovare; i manichini in vetrina sembrano pecore selvatiche con la lana troppo cresciuta e in gran bisogno di una tosatura.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 2|	"Excuse me," you say. She looks up at you with a withering glare. "I'm looking for someone named Pookie."|274|0
units.english: "Excuse me," you say. She looks up at you with a withering glare. "I'm looking for someone named Pookie."
units.italian: "Mi scusi," dici. Lei alza lo sguardo con un'occhiataccia gelida. "Sto cercando qualcuno di nome Pookie."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 2|	Eventually she looks up from the paper and sees you standing there. "Are you Captain <last>?" she asks. You nod.|278|0
units.english: Eventually she looks up from the paper and sees you standing there. "Are you Captain <last>?" she asks. You nod.
units.italian: Alla fine alza lo sguardo dal giornale e ti vede lì. "Lei è il Capitano <last>?" chiede. Fai cenno di sì.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 2|	"Thank heavens," she says. "She's all yours." She hands you the leash and a large bag that appears to be full of chew toys. "Here are her toys, her food, and her... outfits. Which she hates. Feed her twice a day, or she will go berserk. Do not feed her more than twice a day, or she will throw up..."|282|0
units.english: "Thank heavens," she says. "She's all yours." She hands you the leash and a large bag that appears to be full of chew toys. "Here are her toys, her food, and her... outfits. Which she hates. Feed her twice a day, or she will go berserk. Do not feed her more than twice a day, or she will throw up..."
units.italian: "Grazie al cielo," dice. "Ora è sua." Ti consegna il guinzaglio e una grande borsa che sembra piena di giochi da masticare. "Ecco i suoi giochi, il suo cibo e i suoi... vestitini. Che odia. Dalle da mangiare due volte al giorno, o impazzirà. Non darle da mangiare più di due volte al giorno, o vomiterà..."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 2|	As she continues rattling off instructions, you ask, "Wait, Pookie is the dog?"|283|0
units.english: As she continues rattling off instructions, you ask, "Wait, Pookie is the dog?"
units.italian: Mentre continua a snocciolare istruzioni, chiedi: "Aspetti, Pookie è la cagna?"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 2|	"Short for 'Pocahontas,"' she explains. "Good luck, and I hope my sister pays you well." She walks away. There's nothing else you can do but bring Pookie back to your ship, where she immediately squats against the landing strut.|284|0
units.english: "Short for 'Pocahontas,"' she explains. "Good luck, and I hope my sister pays you well." She walks away. There's nothing else you can do but bring Pookie back to your ship, where she immediately squats against the landing strut.
units.italian: "È il diminutivo di 'Pocahontas'," spiega. "Buona fortuna, e spero che mia sorella la paghi bene." Si allontana. Non puoi fare altro che riportare Pookie alla nave, dove subito si accovaccia contro il puntone di atterraggio.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 2|dialog|287|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but your escort carrying Pookie has not arrived! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la tua scorta che porta Pookie non è arrivata! Meglio partire e attendere che le tue scorte arrivino in questo sistema stellare.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 2|dialog|290|0
units.english: In the past few days, Pookie has barked incessantly and thrown up several times despite being fed perfectly on schedule, and the room you've been keeping her in will likely smell like dog urine for months. You are all too happy to return her to her owner, who pays you <payment>.
units.italian: Negli ultimi giorni Pookie ha abbaiato senza sosta e ha vomitato diverse volte nonostante le sia stato dato da mangiare perfettamente secondo l'orario, e la stanza in cui l'hai tenuta probabilmente puzzera di urina di cane per mesi. Sei fin troppo contento di restituirla alla padrona, che ti paga <payment>.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 2|log|291|0
units.english: A dog...
units.italian: Un cane...

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|name|297|0
units.english: Stray Dog
units.italian: Cane randagio

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|description|298|0
units.english: Find a home for a stray dog you picked up on <origin>. She might have been from one of the Paradise Worlds.
units.italian: Trova una casa per una cagna randagia che hai raccolto su <origin>. Potrebbe venire da uno dei Mondi Paradisiaci.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	(Check it out.)|307|0

units.english: You lean back in your seat and turn on your ship's heater. After a while, the neon sign shuts off, and the weather clears up.
units.italian: Ti appoggi allo schienale e accendi il riscaldamento della nave. Dopo un po' l'insegna al neon si spegne e il tempo migliora.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	You wade through the mud as you approach the complex. At its entrance is a stout woman in a black uniform holding a shotgun. When she sees you, she looks at a list in her hand, before saying, "You're alright. Feel free to come in."|313|0
units.english: You wade through the mud as you approach the complex. At its entrance is a stout woman in a black uniform holding a shotgun. When she sees you, she looks at a list in her hand, before saying, "You're alright. Feel free to come in."
units.italian: Ti fai strada nel fango avvicinandoti al complesso. All'ingresso c'è una donna robusta in uniforme nera che tiene un fucile a canna liscia. Quando ti vede, guarda un elenco che ha in mano, poi dice: "Va bene, entra pure."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	The inside of the racing complex is packed to capacity. Around you is a swarm of elbows and shoulders, jutting into you while you worm your way through the crowd. units.english: The inside of the racing complex is packed to capacity. Around you is a swarm of elbows and shoulders, jutting into you while you worm your way through the crowd. The sounds of rancorous conversation blend in with the pounding of rain on the roof as you glimpse a sight of the main attraction: a large, fenced-off oval. White lines inside the area form racing lanes, and arranged on the far side of the track are four cages covered with cloth.
units.italian: L'interno del complesso di corse è pieno fino all'inverosimile. Attorno a te c'è uno sciame di gomiti e spalle che ti si ficcano addosso mentre ti fai largo tra la folla. I suoni delle conversazioni rissose si mescolano al tamburellare della pioggia sul tetto mentre intravedi l'attrazione principale: un grande ovale recintato. Le linee bianche all'interno formano le corsie, e sul lato opposto della pista sono disposte quattro gabbie coperte di tela.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	As you reach the boundary of the track, a loud siren fills the air, causing the crowd to fall silent.|315|0
units.english: As you reach the boundary of the track, a loud siren fills the air, causing the crowd to fall silent.
units.italian: Quando raggiungi il bordo della pista, una sirena forte riempie l'aria e fa ammutolire la folla.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	"What's going on?"|317|0
units.english: "What's going on?"
units.italian: "Che succede?"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	(Quietly observe.)|318|0
units.english: (Quietly observe.)
units.italian: (Osserva in silenzio.)

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	When you try to open your mouth to speak, a hand shushes you, appearing as suddenly as it disappears.|320|0
units.english: When you try to open your mouth to speak, a hand shushes you, appearing as suddenly as it disappears.
units.italian: Quando provi ad aprire bocca per parlare, una mano ti zittisce, apparendo e sparendo con la stessa rapidità.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	The siren ends, and a greasy voice takes its place. "Welcome, one and all, to the grand biweekly hound race! Before we collect your wagers, let me introduce you to our fine racing stock for the night!"|322|0
units.english: The siren ends, and a greasy voice takes its place. "Welcome, one and all, to the grand biweekly hound race! Before we collect your wagers, let me introduce you to our fine racing stock for the night!"
units.italian: La sirena finisce e una voce unta prende il suo posto. "Benvenuti, uno e tutti, alla grande corsa dei segugi di due volte a settimana! Prima di raccogliere le vostre puntate, lasciate che vi presenti il nostro bellissimo parco corridori per la serata!"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	A stagehand hops over the fence and towards the cages while the announcer continues. "Bleedbug is a veteran of the racing track. He's never taken the pole position, but perhaps this will be his lucky day!" The stagehand removes the covering of the innermost cage as a cheer rings out. The dog inside begins ferociously barking upon seeing the cacophony around him, but you can't help but notice how withered Bleedbug's body looks.|323|0
units.english: A stagehand hops over the fence and towards the cages while the announcer continues. "Bleedbug is a veteran of the racing track. He's never taken the pole position, but perhaps this will be his lucky day!" The stagehand removes the covering of the innermost cage as a cheer rings out. The dog inside begins ferociously barking upon seeing the cacophony around him, but you can't help but notice how withered Bleedbug's body looks.
units.italian: Un macchinista salta oltre la recinzione verso le gabbie mentre l'annunciatore continua. "Bleedbug è un veterano della pista. Non ha mai preso la pole position, ma forse oggi è il suo giorno fortunato!" Il macchinista toglie la copertura della gabbia più interna e parte un applauso. Il cane dentro comincia ad abbaiare ferocemente vedendo il chiasso attorno a lui, ma non puoi fare a meno di notare quanto sembri rinsecchito il corpo di Bleedbug.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	"Our second hound is one that you're all familiar with. He's an 18-time victor of the track," the voice pauses, "even if some of his wins were only by technicality." Already, a jeer is rising in the audience. The announcer says, "It's the hound that you don't want to beat: Doom." The booing reaches a peak as the stagehand takes the cover off of the largest cage of the lineup, revealing a gargantuan hound. Doom's body is finely defined, devoid of his competitor's malnutrition. As soon as he sets his eyes on Doom, Bleedbug stops yelling and retreats to the corner of his cage to whimpering. Pleased at his reputation, Doom lets out a thunderous bark.|324|0
units.english: "Our second hound is one that you're all familiar with. He's an 18-time victor of the track," the voice pauses, "even if some of his wins were only by technicality." Already, a jeer is rising in the audience. The announcer says, "It's the hound that you don't want to beat: Doom." The booing reaches a peak as the stagehand takes the cover off of the largest cage of the lineup, revealing a gargantuan hound. Doom's body is finely defined, devoid of his competitor's malnutrition. As soon as he sets his eyes on Doom, Bleedbug stops yelling and retreats to the corner of his cage to whimpering. Pleased at his reputation, Doom lets out a thunderous bark.
units.italian: "Il nostro secondo segugio è uno che tutti voi conoscete. È un vincitore diciotto volte della pista," la voce fa una pausa, "anche se alcune delle sue vittorie sono state solo per cavillo." Già sale un moto di scherno nel pubblico. L'annunciatore dice: "È il segugio che non volete battere: Doom." I fischi raggiungono il picco mentre il macchinista toglie la copertura dalla gabbia più grande della fila, rivelando un segugio gargantuesco. Il corpo di Doom è ben definito, privo della denutrizione del suo concorrente. Appena posa gli occhi su Doom, Bleedbug smette di urlare e si ritira nell'angolo della gabbia guaendo. Soddisfatto della sua reputazione, Doom emette un abbaio tonante.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	(Join in with the booing.)|326|0
units.english: (Join in with the booing.)
units.italian: (Unisciti ai fischi.)

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	(Stay silent.)|327|0
units.english: (Stay silent.)
units.italian: (Resta in silenzio.)

units.english: You pump your fists into the air and join in on the jeering until you are interrupted by the announcer speaking.
units.italian: Alzi i pugni in aria e ti unisci ai fischi finché non vieni interrotto dall'annunciatore che riprende a parlare.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	You silently observe the crowd's boos die when the announcer continues speaking.|332|0
units.english: You silently observe the crowd's boos die when the announcer continues speaking.
units.italian: Osservi in silenzio mentre i fischi della folla si spengono quando l'annunciatore riprende a parlare.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	"Now, our other two racers for the day are all-new." A murmur of anticipation sweeps through the audience. "Our first newcomer is a fine lady. Rumored to be from the wilderness of Zenith, can everyone put their hands together for Zinc!" The cover over the third cage is taken off to reveal a creature that is clearly not a dog. Her long, gray fur and piercing, golden eyes mark her as a far more graceful and feral beast, though underneath her coat, you spot atrophied muscles. Zinc initially stands unfazed by the crowd and the other dogs, calmly observing her surroundings. When Doom spots the wolf ignoring him, he begins to bark louder and louder, until she abruptly stares at him with an inscrutable expression.|334|0
units.english: "Now, our other two racers for the day are all-new." A murmur of anticipation sweeps through the audience. "Our first newcomer is a fine lady. Rumored to be from the wilderness of Zenith, can everyone put their hands together for Zinc!" The cover over the third cage is taken off to reveal a creature that is clearly not a dog. Her long, gray fur and piercing, golden eyes mark her as a far more graceful and feral beast, though underneath her coat, you spot atrophied muscles. Zinc initially stands unfazed by the crowd and the other dogs, calmly observing her surroundings. When Doom spots the wolf ignoring him, he begins to bark louder and louder, until she abruptly stares at him with an inscrutable expression.
units.italian: "Ora, i nostri altri due corridori di oggi sono tutti nuovi." Un mormorio di attesa attraversa il pubblico. "La nostra prima debuttante è una bella signora. Si dice che venga dalle terre selvagge di Zenith: un applauso per Zinc!" La copertura della terza gabbia viene tolta e rivela una creatura che chiaramente non è un cane. La sua lunga pelliccia grigia e i suoi occhi dorati e penetranti la rivelano una bestia molto più elegante e selvatica, anche se sotto il mantello noti muscoli atrofizzati. All'inizio Zinc resta imperturbabile davanti alla folla e agli altri cani, osservando con calma ciò che la circonda. Quando Doom si accorge che la lupa lo ignora, comincia ad abbaiare sempre più forte, finché lei lo fissa di colpo con un'espressione imperscrutabile.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	"Our final contestant for the day is a most... unorthodox choice. The merchant who graciously donated her to us came with a most fascinating story. She said that the hound comes from the Paradise Worlds, and her owner wanted the pet to have a luxury flight to her holiday home. Well, let's see if she can pay her way to victory here, folks." The audience snickers. "Now, give your best welcomes to Puny!" Puny is easily the frailest of the dogs, barely more than skin and bones. White whispers of hair clump around her head, chest, and ankles, and the bottom of her cage is wet. None of the other racers acknowledge her, but the crowd is rearing to volley a variety of curses and slurs at her, as though an actual Paradise World baron was in the cage. As you look at the poodle, you can't help but feel a strange sense of familiarity.|335|0
units.english: "Our final contestant for the day is a most... unorthodox choice. The merchant who graciously donated her to us came with a most fascinating story. She said that the hound comes from the Paradise Worlds, and her owner wanted the pet to have a luxury flight to her holiday home. Well, let's see if she can pay her way to victory here, folks." The audience snickers. "Now, give your best welcomes to Puny!" Puny is easily the frailest of the dogs, barely more than skin and bones. White whispers of hair clump around her head, chest, and ankles, and the bottom of her cage is wet. None of the other racers acknowledge her, but the crowd is rearing to volley a variety of curses and slurs at her, as though an actual Paradise World baron was in the cage. As you look at the poodle, you can't help but feel a strange sense of familiarity.
units.italian: "Il nostro ultimo concorrente di oggi è una scelta alquanto... poco ortodossa. Il mercante che ce l'ha gentilmente donata ci è arrivato con una storia molto affascinante. Ha detto che il segugio viene dai Mondi Paradisiaci, e che la padrona voleva far fare all'animale un volo di lusso verso la casa per le vacanze. Beh, vediamo se qui può pagarsi la strada verso la vittoria, gente." Il pubblico ridacchia. "Ora, fate il vostro miglior benvenuto a Puny!" Puny è facilmente la più gracile dei cani, poco più che pelle e ossa. Ciuffi di pelo bianco le si addensano attorno alla testa, al petto e alle caviglie, e il fondo della sua gabbia è bagnato. Nessuno degli altri corridori la considera, ma la folla è pronta a scagliarle addosso ogni sorta di imprecazioni e insulti, come se nella gabbia ci fosse davvero un barone dei Mondi Paradisiaci. Guardando la barboncina, non puoi fare a meno di provare uno strano senso di familiarità.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	You feel your back get nudged, and turn to see a woman dressed in rags holding four buckets filled with credits. The names of the racers are crudely written on each of them. "Betting is 3,000 credits," she says unusually sweetly.|336|0

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	A red light on the ceiling turns on, and the audience shouts, "Three!" A second one lights up. "Two!" A third light, this time yellow, turns on. "One!"|358|0
units.english: A red light on the ceiling turns on, and the audience shouts, "Three!" A second one lights up. "Two!" A third light, this time yellow, turns on. "One!"
units.italian: Si accende una luce rossa sul soffitto e il pubblico grida: "Tre!" Se ne accende una seconda. "Due!" Una terza luce, questa volta gialla. "Uno!"

units.english: A green light appears, and the crowd descends into chaos as the cage doors open.
units.italian: Appare una luce verde, e la folla precipita nel caos mentre le porte delle gabbie si aprono.

units.english: The first to move is Bleedbug, desperate to get as far away from Doom as possible. Doom himself has his eyes set on a different target. As soon as the doors open, he rushes over the lane lines towards Zinc and bares his teeth for a bite. Anticipating this, Zinc dodges beneath the attack, and lunges in with her mouth open. Doom responds to the threat by lowering his head and bashing into her, and the two animals are quickly locked into a brutal mess of teeth and blood. The crowd goes wild at the spectacle unfolding before them as the brawl approaches your section of the fence.
units.italian: Il primo a muoversi è Bleedbug, disperato di allontanarsi il più possibile da Doom. Doom però ha gli occhi puntati su un bersaglio diverso. Appena le porte si aprono, si lancia oltre le linee delle corsie verso Zinc e mostra i denti per un morso. Prevedendolo, Zinc schiva sotto l'attacco e si getta in avanti a bocca aperta. Doom risponde alla minaccia abbassando la testa e caricandola, e i due animali si bloccano rapidamente in un brutto groviglio di denti e sangue. La folla impazzisce davanti allo spettacolo che si svolge sotto i suoi occhi mentre la rissa si avvicina alla vostra sezione della recinzione.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	(Continue watching.)|362|0

units.english: Looking on, you are suddenly thrown backward when the beasts smash into the fence in front of you. Lying on the ground, you look down and see Zinc and Doom tearing into each other outside of the track, inches from your feet.
units.italian: Mentre guardi, vieni improvvisamente buttato all'indietro quando le bestie si schiantano contro la recinzione davanti a te. Disteso a terra, guardi in basso e vedi Zinc e Doom che si sbranano fuori dalla pista, a pochi centimetri dai tuoi piedi.

In pochi secondi la tua pelle è ridotta a brandelli da due animali troppo immersi nella sete di sangue per accorgersi che un altro corpo si è unito alla mischia. Sanguini a terra mentre la folla esulta per il massacro di un essere umano.

Mentre i due animali urlano di dolore, ti fai largo tra la folla che guarda, sperando di sfuggire al pericolo. units.italian: Ti giri e ti allontani dalla recinzione. Pochi istanti dopo senti due gridi di dolore accompagnati dal suono del legno che si scheggia. Guardando indietro di sbieco, vedi che Zinc e Doom stanno combattendo fuori dalla pista, con la folla che delira davanti alla violenza.

units.english: You look on at the duel, as does the rest of the building. The crowd has already taken sides, with some shouting Zinc's name and others shouting Doom's. Doom initially appears to have the upper hand, ramming himself into Zinc with impunity as she is sent sprawling. However, when Doom goes in for another tackle, Zinc dashes in and sinks her teeth into his neck. His roars of pain diminish into whimpers as blood spills readily on the complex's floor.
units.italian: Guardi il duello, come tutto il resto dell'edificio. La folla ha già preso posizione: alcuni gridano il nome di Zinc, altri quello di Doom. All'inizio Doom sembra avere la meglio, caricando Zinc con impunità mentre lei viene scaraventata via. Quando però Doom va per un'altra carica, Zinc scatta e gli affonda i denti nel collo. I suoi ruggiti di dolore si affievoliscono in guaiti mentre il sangue si riversa sul pavimento del complesso.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	Suddenly, a gunshot rings out throughout the building. The two beasts fall over as the stagehand steps forward holding a shotgun. The crowd is left in silence for a moment, until they start to jeer and boo, angered by the unsatisfying end to the duel. The stagehand responds by pointing his gun up and firing again. "That's enough!" he yells. "If you freaks want your bloodsports, then go to the gladiator stadium, or a cockfighting ring. But this establishment will not support such degeneracy!" The crowd goes quiet, but out of the corner of your eye, you see some mean-faced figures reach into their pockets.|383|0
units.english: Suddenly, a gunshot rings out throughout the building. The two beasts fall over as the stagehand steps forward holding a shotgun. The crowd is left in silence for a moment, until they start to jeer and boo, angered by the unsatisfying end to the duel. The stagehand responds by pointing his gun up and firing again. "That's enough!" he yells. "If you freaks want your bloodsports, then go to the gladiator stadium, or a cockfighting ring. But this establishment will not support such degeneracy!" The crowd goes quiet, but out of the corner of your eye, you see some mean-faced figures reach into their pockets.
units.italian: All'improvviso uno sparo risuona in tutto l'edificio. Le due bestie crollano mentre il macchinista avanza con il fucile in mano. La folla resta in silenzio per un momento, poi comincia a fischiare e a urlare, arrabbiata per la fine insoddisfacente del duello. Il macchinista risponde alzando la canna e sparando di nuovo. "Basta così!" urla. "Se voi mostri volete i vostri spettacoli di sangue, allora andate allo stadio dei gladiatori, o in un ring di combattimenti tra galli. Ma questo locale non sosterrà una tale degenerazione!" La folla ammutolisce, ma con la coda dell'occhio vedi alcune figure dall'aria cattiva che frugano nelle tasche.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	(Get out before it gets ugly.)|385|0
units.english: (Get out before it gets ugly.)
units.italian: (Esci prima che degeneri.)

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	(Stay for a while longer.)|387|0
units.english: (Stay for a while longer.)
units.italian: (Resta ancora un po'.)

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	Continuing to look on, you hear a loud bang to your right as the stagehand gasps in pain and collapses. You turn to see that a mustached man next to you has his gun raised. Before you can react, you hear another gunshot and see a spurt of blood erupt from the man's temple. Almost instantly, the entire audience is up in arms as gunfire comes in from every direction. Acting instinctually, you duck down and crawl through the forest of legs towards the exit. Once there, you reach your hand up and push the door open before running out.|388|0
units.english: Continuing to look on, you hear a loud bang to your right as the stagehand gasps in pain and collapses. You turn to see that a mustached man next to you has his gun raised. Before you can react, you hear another gunshot and see a spurt of blood erupt from the man's temple. Almost instantly, the entire audience is up in arms as gunfire comes in from every direction. Acting instinctually, you duck down and crawl through the forest of legs towards the exit. Once there, you reach your hand up and push the door open before running out.
units.italian: Continuando a guardare, senti un forte botto alla tua destra mentre il macchinista sussulta di dolore e crolla. Ti giri e vedi che un uomo baffuto accanto a te ha la pistola alzata. Prima che tu possa reagire senti un altro sparo e vedi uno schizzo di sangue erompere dalla tempia dell'uomo. Quasi all'istante l'intero pubblico è in subbuglio mentre gli spari arrivano da ogni direzione. Agendo d'istinto ti abbassi e strisci attraverso la foresta di gambe verso l'uscita. Una volta lì alzi una mano e spingi la porta prima di correre fuori.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|label|390|0
units.english: nope late
units.italian: nope late

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	As you turn around, you hear a volley of gunshots from behind, and decide to run out of the building, tackling the door open.|391|0
units.english: As you turn around, you hear a volley of gunshots from behind, and decide to run out of the building, tackling the door open.
units.italian: Mentre ti volti, senti una scarica di spari alle tue spalle e decidi di correre fuori dall'edificio, sfondando la porta.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	You head towards the exit, pushing aside audience members completely captivated by the fight. Flinging the door open, you hear a gunshot from behind, and decide to run out.|394|0
units.english: You head towards the exit, pushing aside audience members completely captivated by the fight. Flinging the door open, you hear a gunshot from behind, and decide to run out.
units.italian: Ti dirigi verso l'uscita, spingendo da parte gli spettatori completamente catturati dalla rissa. Spalanchi la porta e senti uno sparo alle tue spalle, e decidi di correre fuori.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	As you step outside, you are greeted by sheets of rain lashing you. The strength of the torrent almost causes you to fall backwards, but you manage to steady yourself. You take a glance back at the racing complex to find that the guard in the black uniform is missing. You turn to begin the trek back to your ship, but halfway there, you feel something touch your lower leg.|396|0
units.english: As you step outside, you are greeted by sheets of rain lashing you. The strength of the torrent almost causes you to fall backwards, but you manage to steady yourself. You take a glance back at the racing complex to find that the guard in the black uniform is missing. You turn to begin the trek back to your ship, but halfway there, you feel something touch your lower leg.
units.italian: Appena esci, sei accolto da lenzuolate di pioggia che ti frustano. La forza del diluvio quasi ti fa cadere all'indietro, ma riesci a restare in piedi. Dai un'occhiata indietro verso il complesso di corse e scopri che la guardia in uniforme nera è sparita. Ti volti per iniziare il cammino verso la nave, ma a metà strada senti qualcosa sfiorarti la parte inferiore della gamba.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	(Turn around.)|398|0
units.english: (Turn around.)
units.italian: (Voltati.)

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	(Run away.)|400|0
units.english: (Run away.)
units.italian: (Scappa.)

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	You begin to run, but slip in the mud and fall on your face. You roll over to come face-to-face with a dour-looking dog eyeing you. Sitting up, you recognize the poodle as Puny, who must have snuck out of the complex during all the commotion. As you get off of the ground, Puny looks up at you with puppy-dog eyes.|401|0
units.english: You begin to run, but slip in the mud and fall on your face. You roll over to come face-to-face with a dour-looking dog eyeing you. Sitting up, you recognize the poodle as Puny, who must have snuck out of the complex during all the commotion. As you get off of the ground, Puny looks up at you with puppy-dog eyes.
units.italian: Cominci a correre, ma scivoli nel fango e cadi faccia a terra. Ti giri e ti trovi faccia a faccia con un cane dall'aria arcigna che ti fissa. Ti metti a sedere e riconosci la barboncina: è Puny, che dev'essere sgattaiolata fuori dal complesso durante il trambusto. Mentre ti rialzi da terra, Puny ti guarda con gli occhi da cucciolo.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	You turn around and come face-to-face with a dour-looking dog looking up at you with puppy-dog eyes. Inspecting it, you recognize the poodle as Puny, who must have snuck out of the complex during all the commotion.|404|0
units.english: You turn around and come face-to-face with a dour-looking dog looking up at you with puppy-dog eyes. Inspecting it, you recognize the poodle as Puny, who must have snuck out of the complex during all the commotion.
units.italian: Ti volti e ti trovi faccia a faccia con un cane dall'aria arcigna che ti guarda con gli occhi da cucciolo. Osservandolo, riconosci la barboncina: è Puny, che dev'essere sgattaiolata fuori dal complesso durante tutto il trambusto.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	(Pet her.)|407|0
units.english: (Pet her.)
units.italian: (Accarezzala.)

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	(Shoo her.)|408|0
units.english: (Shoo her.)
units.italian: (Scacciala.)

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	You crouch down and rub the soggy tufts of hair on Puny's head. As you continue, a smile creeps onto her face, beaming in spite of the soaking rain. You think about what to do with her.|410|0
units.english: You crouch down and rub the soggy tufts of hair on Puny's head. As you continue, a smile creeps onto her face, beaming in spite of the soaking rain. You think about what to do with her.
units.italian: Ti accovacci e strofini i ciuffi bagnati sulla testa di Puny. Mentre continui, un sorriso le si fa strada sul muso, raggiante nonostante la pioggia battente. Pensi a cosa farne.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	(Bring Puny aboard my ship.)|412|0
units.english: (Bring Puny aboard my ship.)
units.italian: (Porta Puny a bordo della mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	(Shoo Puny off.)|413|0
units.english: (Shoo Puny off.)
units.italian: (Manda via Puny.)

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	You pick up Puny and carry her onboard. As you dry yourselves, you think back to what the announcer said about Puny being owned by someone from the Paradise Worlds, and wonder where you might be able to drop her off.|417|0
units.english: You pick up Puny and carry her onboard. As you dry yourselves, you think back to what the announcer said about Puny being owned by someone from the Paradise Worlds, and wonder where you might be able to drop her off.
units.italian: Prendi Puny in braccio e la porti a bordo. Mentre vi asciugate, ripensi a quello che l'annunciatore ha detto, che Puny apparteneva a qualcuno dei Mondi Paradisiaci, e ti chiedi dove potresti lasciarla.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	You pick up Puny and carry her onboard. As you dry yourselves, you think back to what the announcer said about Puny being owned by someone from the Paradise Worlds, and wonder where you might be able to drop her off.|420|0
units.english: You pick up Puny and carry her onboard. As you dry yourselves, you think back to what the announcer said about Puny being owned by someone from the Paradise Worlds, and wonder where you might be able to drop her off.
units.italian: Sollevi Puny e la porti a bordo. Mentre vi asciugate, ti torna in mente la frase dell'annunciatore sulla padrona di Puny, una persona dei Mondi Paradisiaci, e ti domandi dove potresti affidarla.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	As you step into the cockpit, you recall the bet you put on the hound race. Looks like you won't be getting your money back.|421|0
units.english: As you step into the cockpit, you recall the bet you put on the hound race. Looks like you won't be getting your money back.
units.italian: Quando entri in cabina di pilotaggio, ricordi la puntata che hai messo alla corsa dei segugi. Pare proprio che non rivedrai i tuoi soldi.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	You wiggle your leg around to scare Puny off. She runs into the mist, vanishing from sight. You turn back and manage to reach your ship, changing into a dry set of clothes.|426|0
units.english: You wiggle your leg around to scare Puny off. She runs into the mist, vanishing from sight. You turn back and manage to reach your ship, changing into a dry set of clothes.
units.italian: Agiti la gamba per scacciare Puny. Lei corre nella nebbia e sparisce alla vista. Ti volti e riesci a raggiungere la nave, dove ti cambi con dei vestiti asciutti.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|label|428|0
units.english: remember decline
units.italian: remember decline

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	You wiggle your leg around to scare Puny off. She runs into the mist, vanishing from sight. You turn back and manage to reach your ship, changing into a dry set of clothes.|429|0
units.english: You wiggle your leg around to scare Puny off. She runs into the mist, vanishing from sight. You turn back and manage to reach your ship, changing into a dry set of clothes.
units.italian: Scuoti la gamba per spaventare Puny e mandarla via. Lei si infila nella nebbia e sparisce. Ti giri indietro e riesci a raggiungere la nave, dove ti metti addosso un completo asciutto.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 3|	As you step into the cockpit, you recall the bet you put on the hound race. Looks like you won't be getting your money back.|430|0
units.english: As you step into the cockpit, you recall the bet you put on the hound race. Looks like you won't be getting your money back.
units.italian: Appena ti siedi ai comandi, ti torna in mente la scommessa fatta alla corsa dei segugi. A quanto pare quei soldi sono persi.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 4|After landing on <origin>, you look for a way to reach as many people on the planet as possible in order to find Puny's owner.
