You describe the poodle's appearance to the best of your abilities, and also mention how she was traveling for a vacation when she was abducted.|449|0
units.english: After landing on <origin>, you look for a way to reach as many people on the planet as possible in order to find Puny's owner. One of the receptionists at a planetary information desk says that she can put out a notice for a lost dog on a planetwide notice board, if you're able to put in a detailed enough description of Puny. You describe the poodle's appearance to the best of your abilities, and also mention how she was traveling for a vacation when she was abducted.
units.italian: Dopo l'atterraggio su <origin>, cerchi un modo per raggiungere il maggior numero possibile di persone sul pianeta e trovare la padrona di Puny. Una delle receptionist di un banco informazioni planetario dice che può pubblicare un avviso di cane smarrito su una bacheca che copre tutto il pianeta, se riesci a fornire una descrizione di Puny abbastanza dettagliata. Descrivi l'aspetto della barboncina al meglio delle tue capacità, e menzioni anche che stava viaggiando per una vacanza quando è stata rapita.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 4|	When you check back with the receptionist the next morning, she tells you that nobody has approached the offer.|450|0
units.english: When you check back with the receptionist the next morning, she tells you that nobody has approached the offer.
units.italian: Quando torni dalla receptionist la mattina dopo, ti dice che nessuno ha risposto all'annuncio.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 4|You put a description of Puny on a planetwide notice board. By the time the next day arrives, you've received no offers in response.|453|0
units.english: You put a description of Puny on a planetwide notice board. By the time the next day arrives, you've received no offers in response.
units.italian: Pubblichi una descrizione di Puny su una bacheca che copre tutto il pianeta. Quando arriva il giorno dopo, non hai ricevuto alcuna offerta.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|When you land on <origin>, you look for a way to reach as many people on the planet as possible in order to find Puny's owner. One of the receptionists at a planetary information desk says that she can put out a notice for a lost dog on a planetwide notice board, if you're able to put in a detailed enough description of Puny. You describe the poodle's appearance to the best of your abilities, and also mention how she was meant to be transported to a vacation location before being abducted.|468|0
units.english: When you land on <origin>, you look for a way to reach as many people on the planet as possible in order to find Puny's owner. One of the receptionists at a planetary information desk says that she can put out a notice for a lost dog on a planetwide notice board, if you're able to put in a detailed enough description of Puny. You describe the poodle's appearance to the best of your abilities, and also mention how she was meant to be transported to a vacation location before being abducted.
units.italian: Quando atterri su <origin>, cerchi un modo per raggiungere il maggior numero possibile di persone sul pianeta e trovare la padrona di Puny. Una delle receptionist di un banco informazioni planetario dice che può pubblicare un avviso di cane smarrito su una bacheca che copre tutto il pianeta, se riesci a fornire una descrizione di Puny abbastanza dettagliata. Descrivi l'aspetto della barboncina al meglio delle tue capacità, e menzioni anche che doveva essere trasportata in una località di vacanza prima di essere rapita.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|You approach a receptionist to put a description of Puny on a planetwide notice board.|471|0
units.english: You approach a receptionist to put a description of Puny on a planetwide notice board.
units.italian: Ti avvicini a una receptionist per far pubblicare una descrizione di Puny su una bacheca che copre tutto il pianeta.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	The next day, you visit the receptionist. When she sees you, she tells you that one message came in response, saying that the dog was theirs. You copy the address provided and hail down a taxi.|473|0
units.english: The next day, you visit the receptionist. When she sees you, she tells you that one message came in response, saying that the dog was theirs. You copy the address provided and hail down a taxi.
units.italian: Il giorno dopo vai dalla receptionist. Quando ti vede, ti dice che è arrivato un solo messaggio in risposta, in cui si afferma che il cane è di quella persona. Copi l'indirizzo fornito e fermi un taxi.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	The address brings you to a stark white mansion upon a cliff overlooking the ocean. A path snakes down from the entrance of the mansion to a large, gold-plated gate. You bring Puny out from the taxi and ring the doorbell next to the gate. A minute later, a servant in a prim suit approaches. As soon as she sees him, Puny straightens up, holding her head high.|474|0
units.english: The address brings you to a stark white mansion upon a cliff overlooking the ocean. A path snakes down from the entrance of the mansion to a large, gold-plated gate. You bring Puny out from the taxi and ring the doorbell next to the gate. A minute later, a servant in a prim suit approaches. As soon as she sees him, Puny straightens up, holding her head high.
units.italian: L'indirizzo ti porta a una villa bianco candore su una scogliera a picco sull'oceano. Un sentiero serpeggia dall'ingresso della villa fino a un grande cancello placcato d'oro. Fai scendere Puny dal taxi e suoni il campanello accanto al cancello. Un minuto dopo si avvicina un domestico in un abito composto. Appena lo vede, Puny si raddrizza e tiene la testa alta.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"I'm <first>, and I'm here to return a missing pet."|476|0
units.english: "I'm <first>, and I'm here to return a missing pet."
units.italian: "Sono <first>, e sono qui per restituire un animale smarrito."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	(Wait quietly.)|477|0
units.english: (Wait quietly.)
units.italian: (Aspetta in silenzio.)

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	The servant says, "Ah, you're the one with the dog. Come inside, mistress has been expecting you."|479|0
units.english: The servant says, "Ah, you're the one with the dog. Come inside, mistress has been expecting you."
units.italian: Il domestico dice: "Ah, lei è quello con il cane. Entri, la signora la sta aspettando."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	When he spots you, the servant says, "Welcome. Come inside, mistress has been expecting you."|482|0
units.english: When he spots you, the servant says, "Welcome. Come inside, mistress has been expecting you."
units.italian: Quando ti nota, il domestico dice: "Benvenuto. Entri, la signora la sta aspettando."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	The walk to the front of the house is arduous; you pass through several different stadium-sized gardens along the way, each dedicated to a different type of biome. Looking up at the sky, you see the remnants of clouds contort unnaturally around invisible pillars. As you follow the servant, he looks back at you repeatedly, checking that you're still following. You decide to look behind yourself, and see Puny eagerly following. She has somewhat recovered from her time on Freedom, but her body is still little more than skin and bone.|484|0
units.english: The walk to the front of the house is arduous; you pass through several different stadium-sized gardens along the way, each dedicated to a different type of biome. Looking up at the sky, you see the remnants of clouds contort unnaturally around invisible pillars. As you follow the servant, he looks back at you repeatedly, checking that you're still following. You decide to look behind yourself, and see Puny eagerly following. She has somewhat recovered from her time on Freedom, but her body is still little more than skin and bone.
units.italian: La camminata fino alla facciata della casa è faticosa; lungo il percorso attraversi diversi giardini grandi come stadi, ognuno dedicato a un tipo diverso di bioma. Alzando lo sguardo al cielo, vedi i resti delle nuvole torcersi innaturalmente attorno a pilastri invisibili. Mentre segui il domestico, lui si volta più volte a controllare che tu lo stia ancora seguendo. Decidi di guardarti indietro e vedi Puny che ti segue con entusiasmo. Si è un po' ripresa dal periodo passato su Freedom, ma il suo corpo è ancora poco più che pelle e ossa.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	By the time you reach the mansion, your skin is slightly sunburnt. The servant walks up to the oddly tall door and presses the doorbell before moving to the side, hands folded behind his back. The bell is answered by a woman with a monstrous hairdo, barely able to fit in the doorway. Puny breaks into barking as soon as she sees her, but the woman ignores the barking and says, "Walters, who is this?"|485|0
units.english: By the time you reach the mansion, your skin is slightly sunburnt. The servant walks up to the oddly tall door and presses the doorbell before moving to the side, hands folded behind his back. The bell is answered by a woman with a monstrous hairdo, barely able to fit in the doorway. Puny breaks into barking as soon as she sees her, but the woman ignores the barking and says, "Walters, who is this?"
units.italian: Quando raggiungi la villa, la tua pelle è leggermente scottata dal sole. Il domestico si avvicina alla porta stranamente alta e preme il campanello, poi si sposta di lato con le mani intrecciate dietro la schiena. Ad aprire è una donna con un'acconciatura mostruosa, a malapena in grado di stare nella cornice della porta. Puny scoppia ad abbaiare appena la vede, ma la donna ignora gli abbai e dice: "Walters, chi è questo?"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"It's the captain who put out a description of Pookie, Madam Pemefrey," the servant replies.|486|0
units.english: "It's the captain who put out a description of Pookie, Madam Pemefrey," the servant replies.
units.italian: "È il capitano che ha pubblicato una descrizione di Pookie, signora Pemefrey," risponde il domestico.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	When she hears this, Pemefrey's expression changes from annoyance to elation. "Really? Oh, I can't thank enough for this, dearie. How was it rescuing her? Did you have to barter with smugglers to track her down? Chase down kidnappers to free her? Battle with warlords for her safety?"|487|0
units.english: When she hears this, Pemefrey's expression changes from annoyance to elation. "Really? Oh, I can't thank enough for this, dearie. How was it rescuing her? Did you have to barter with smugglers to track her down? Chase down kidnappers to free her? Battle with warlords for her safety?"
units.italian: Sentendo questo, l'espressione di Pemefrey passa dal fastidio all'esultanza. "Davvero? Oh, non so come ringraziarla, caro. Com'è stato salvarla? Ha dovuto trattare con i contrabbandieri per rintracciarla? Inseguire i rapitori per liberarla? Combattere contro signori della guerra per la sua incolumità?"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"It was an adventure and a half saving her."|489|0
units.english: "It was an adventure and a half saving her."
units.italian: "È stata un'avventura e mezza salvarla."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"It wasn't anything too hard."|490|0
units.english: "It wasn't anything too hard."
units.italian: "Non è stato niente di troppo difficile."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"Wait, did you say Pookie?"|492|0
units.english: "Wait, did you say Pookie?"
units.italian: "Aspetti, ha detto Pookie?"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"I'm sure it was. Now, where's my darling Pookie?"|494|0
units.english: "I'm sure it was. Now, where's my darling Pookie?"
units.italian: "Ne sono certa. Ora, dov'è la mia adorata Pookie?"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"Oh. Well, where's my darling Pookie?"|497|0
units.english: "Oh. Well, where's my darling Pookie?"
units.italian: "Oh. Beh, dov'è la mia adorata Pookie?"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	Pemefrey chuckles haughtily. "Of course? Why, did you not realize that the purebred you saved is none other than the great Pocahontas? Now, show me my darling."|500|0
units.english: Pemefrey chuckles haughtily. "Of course? Why, did you not realize that the purebred you saved is none other than the great Pocahontas? Now, show me my darling."
units.italian: Pemefrey ridacchia con alterigia. "Ma certo? Come, non si era accorto che la purosangue che ha salvato altri non è che la grande Pocahontas? Ora, mi mostri la mia adorata."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	You pick up Puny and show her to the lady. When she makes eye contact with the poodle, her face contorts with anger. "What do you take me for, some kind of Dirt Belter?"|502|0
units.english: You pick up Puny and show her to the lady. When she makes eye contact with the poodle, her face contorts with anger. "What do you take me for, some kind of Dirt Belter?"
units.italian: Prendi Puny e la mostri alla signora. Quando lei incrocia lo sguardo della barboncina, il suo viso si contrae di rabbia. "Per chi mi prende, per una specie di abitante del Dirt Belt?"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"Hey, I'm from the Dirt Belt!"|504|0
units.english: "Hey, I'm from the Dirt Belt!"
units.italian: "Ehi, io vengo dal Dirt Belt!"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"I would never in a million years, ma'am."|507|0
units.english: "I would never in a million years, ma'am."
units.italian: "Non in un milione di anni, signora."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"What do you mean?"|511|0
units.english: "What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Cosa vuole dire?"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"I'm sorry?"|513|0
units.english: "I'm sorry?"
units.italian: "Mi scusi?"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	She tosses her head to the side. "Then I mean it twice as much!"|515|0
units.english: She tosses her head to the side. "Then I mean it twice as much!"
units.italian: Lei scuote la testa di lato. "Allora lo dico due volte tanto!"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	She scoffs. "Flattery will get you nowhere!"|518|0
units.english: She scoffs. "Flattery will get you nowhere!"
units.italian: Sbuffa. "Con le lusinghe non va da nessuna parte!"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	She hisses. "If you wanted to be sorry, then you should never have tried to trick me in the first place!"|521|0
units.english: She hisses. "If you wanted to be sorry, then you should never have tried to trick me in the first place!"
units.italian: Sibila. "Se voleva scusarsi, non avrebbe mai dovuto provare a ingannarmi!"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	Pemefrey thrusts an accusing finger at Puny. "My dog would never be as scruffy, as ugly, as this mutt! You are trying to deceive me by picking some mongrel off of the street and claiming it as mine!"|523|0
units.english: Pemefrey thrusts an accusing finger at Puny. "My dog would never be as scruffy, as ugly, as this mutt! You are trying to deceive me by picking some mongrel off of the street and claiming it as mine!"
units.italian: Pemefrey punta un dito accusatorio verso Puny. "Il mio cane non sarebbe mai così arruffato, così brutto, come questo bastardo! Lei sta cercando di ingannarmi prendendo un randagio dalla strada e spacciandolo per il mio!"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	Walters walks up to his master, saying, "But Madam, how could this captain provide such an accurate description of how Pookie was abducted if-"|524|0
units.english: Walters walks up to his master, saying, "But Madam, how could this captain provide such an accurate description of how Pookie was abducted if-"
units.italian: Walters si avvicina alla padrona e dice: "Ma signora, come poteva questo capitano fornire una descrizione così accurata di come Pookie è stata rapita se-"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	Pemefrey snaps her head to look back at her servant. "Walters! I thought you were on my side!" She holds her hands on her chest. "It would be such a shame if you ruined our friendship like this. Why, I wouldn't be able to bear to keep you around if you betrayed me like that."|525|0
units.english: Pemefrey snaps her head to look back at her servant. "Walters! I thought you were on my side!" She holds her hands on her chest. "It would be such a shame if you ruined our friendship like this. Why, I wouldn't be able to bear to keep you around if you betrayed me like that."
units.italian: Pemefrey gira la testa di scatto verso il domestico. "Walters! Credevo fossi dalla mia parte!" Si porta le mani al petto. "Sarebbe un peccato se rovinassi la nostra amicizia così. Perché non potrei sopportare di tenerti con me se mi tradissi in questo modo."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	Walters shoots a desperate glance at you while stepping back, but otherwise says nothing.|526|0
units.english: Walters shoots a desperate glance at you while stepping back, but otherwise says nothing.
units.italian: Walters ti lancia uno sguardo disperato mentre fa un passo indietro, ma per il resto non dice nulla.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"Now, where was I... oh, right. You. Out. Now." She claps twice, jumping Walters to attention, who beckons you and Puny back to the gate of the mansion.|527|0
units.english: "Now, where was I... oh, right. You. Out. Now." She claps twice, jumping Walters to attention, who beckons you and Puny back to the gate of the mansion.
units.italian: "Dunque, dov'ero... ah, già. Lei. Fuori. Subito." Batte le mani due volte, facendo scattare sull'attenti Walters, che ti fa cenno di tornare con Puny al cancello della villa.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	You slam the door of the taxi shut as Walters locks the gate. The return journey is somewhat somber, with even Puny wearing a frown. When you look back up from Puny, you find yourself in a far more humble region of <origin>. The grandiose manors built into impossible locations are far distant, replaced with a small suburban town that would not look out of place in the Dirt Belt were it not for the picturesque mountain ranges surrounding it.|528|0
units.english: You slam the door of the taxi shut as Walters locks the gate. The return journey is somewhat somber, with even Puny wearing a frown. When you look back up from Puny, you find yourself in a far more humble region of <origin>. The grandiose manors built into impossible locations are far distant, replaced with a small suburban town that would not look out of place in the Dirt Belt were it not for the picturesque mountain ranges surrounding it.
units.italian: Sbatti la portiera del taxi mentre Walters chiude il cancello. Il viaggio di ritorno è piuttosto cupo, e persino Puny ha il muso lungo. Quando rialzi lo sguardo da Puny, ti ritrovi in una zona di <origin> molto più modesta. Le ville grandiose incastrate in luoghi impossibili sono ormai lontane, sostituite da una piccola cittadina di periferia che non sfigurerebbe nel Dirt Belt, se non fosse per le pittoresche catene montuose che la circondano.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	While this town is less wealthy than the neighboring estates, it is still unmistakably on a Paradise World, with the street lamps scrubbed and polished to a wasteful degree. As you pass through the commercial district, your eyes catch a sign that says "Antette and Co. Animal Adoption Agency."|529|0
units.english: While this town is less wealthy than the neighboring estates, it is still unmistakably on a Paradise World, with the street lamps scrubbed and polished to a wasteful degree. As you pass through the commercial district, your eyes catch a sign that says "Antette and Co. Animal Adoption Agency."
units.italian: Per quanto questa città sia meno ricca delle tenute vicine, è comunque inequivocabilmente su un Mondo Paradisiaco, con i lampioni stradali strofinati e lucidati fino a un grado sprecone. Mentre attraversi il quartiere commerciale, i tuoi occhi catturano un'insegna che dice "Agenzia di Adozione Animali Antette e Co."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	(Investigate.)|531|0
units.english: (Investigate.)
units.italian: (Indaga.)

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	(Ignore the sign.)|532|0
units.english: (Ignore the sign.)
units.italian: (Ignora l'insegna.)

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	You tell the taxi driver to stop the car and you walk into the adoption center, leading Puny behind you.|535|0
units.english: You tell the taxi driver to stop the car and you walk into the adoption center, leading Puny behind you.
units.italian: Dici al tassista di fermare l'auto ed entri nel centro di adozione, con Puny che ti segue.

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	The inside of the agency is decorated with pale blue wallpaper. To either side of you are rows of plastic chairs, and in front of you is a receptionist looking down at his nails. When he notices you, he lazily says, "Welcome, welcome. What can I do for you."|536|0
units.english: The inside of the agency is decorated with pale blue wallpaper. To either side of you are rows of plastic chairs, and in front of you is a receptionist looking down at his nails. When he notices you, he lazily says, "Welcome, welcome. What can I do for you."
units.italian: L'interno dell'agenzia è tappezzato di carta da parati azzurro pallido. Ai tuoi lati ci sono file di sedie di plastica, e davanti a te una receptionist che si guarda le unghie. Quando ti nota, dice con pigrizia: "Benvenuto, benvenuto. Cosa posso fare per lei?"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	You point down at Puny and say, "Could you find a home for this dog?"|537|0
units.english: You point down at Puny and say, "Could you find a home for this dog?"
units.italian: Indichi Puny e chiedi: "Potrebbe trovare una casa per questo cane?"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	The receptionist leans over the counter to look. "Wow, that's a sorry-looking puppy. What's her name?"|538|0
units.english: The receptionist leans over the counter to look. "Wow, that's a sorry-looking puppy. What's her name?"
units.italian: La receptionist si sporge dal banco per guardare. "Caspita, che cucciola malconcia. Come si chiama?"

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"It's Puny."|540|0
units.english: "It's Puny."
units.italian: "Si chiama Puny."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"It's Pookie."|542|0
units.english: "It's Pookie."
units.italian: "Si chiama Pookie."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"I don't know."|543|0
units.english: "I don't know."
units.italian: "Non lo so."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"That's a nice name." The receptionist steps forward to pick up the poodle before saying, "We'll make sure Pookie gets plenty of care and love. Thank you for bringing her to us."|545|0
units.english: "That's a nice name." The receptionist steps forward to pick up the poodle before saying, "We'll make sure Pookie gets plenty of care and love. Thank you for bringing her to us."
units.italian: "È un bel nome." La receptionist fa un passo avanti per prendere la barboncina, poi dice: "Ci assicureremo che Pookie riceva cure e affetto in abbondanza. Grazie per avercela portata."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	The receptionist winces. "That's... I'm sure we can come up with something better." He steps forward to pick up the poodle before saying, "We'll make sure she gets plenty of care and love. Thank you for bringing her to us."|548|0
units.english: The receptionist winces. "That's... I'm sure we can come up with something better." He steps forward to pick up the poodle before saying, "We'll make sure she gets plenty of care and love. Thank you for bringing her to us."
units.italian: La receptionist fa una smorfia. "Beh... sono sicuro che possiamo trovare qualcosa di meglio." Fa un passo avanti per prendere la barboncina, poi dice: "Ci assicureremo che riceva cure e affetto in abbondanza. Grazie per avercela portata."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	"Well, I'm sure we'll figure out a name for her eventually." The receptionist steps forward to pick up the poodle before saying, "We'll make sure she gets plenty of care and love. Thank you for bringing her to us."|551|0
units.english: "Well, I'm sure we'll figure out a name for her eventually." The receptionist steps forward to pick up the poodle before saying, "We'll make sure she gets plenty of care and love. Thank you for bringing her to us."
units.italian: "Beh, sono sicuro che alla fine le troveremo un nome." La receptionist fa un passo avanti per prendere la barboncina, poi dice: "Ci assicureremo che riceva cure e affetto in abbondanza. Grazie per avercela portata."

units.id: mission:Pookie, Part 5|	You lean back in your seat as the taxi passes through the town without interruption. Not long after you find yourself back in the spaceport, with Puny still in your care. With nowhere else to go, you decide to bring Puny aboard your ship. As you lead her, she happily strolls up the landing ramp and settles into one of your bunks.|562|0
units.english: You lean back in your seat as the taxi passes through the town without interruption. Not long after you find yourself back in the spaceport, with Puny still in your care. With nowhere else to go, you decide to bring Puny aboard your ship. As you lead her, she happily strolls up the landing ramp and settles into one of your bunks.
units.italian: Ti appoggi allo schienale mentre il taxi attraversa la città senza interruzioni. Non molto dopo ti ritrovi di nuovo allo spazioporto, con Puny ancora alle tue cure. Non avendo altro posto dove andare, decidi di portare Puny a bordo della nave. Mentre la guidi, lei sale con gioia sulla rampa di atterraggio e si sistema in una delle cuccette.
